procedure: Header stacks and cell values read from page renders (page.crop().to_image), 800-1300 dpi zooms per cell cluster, saved under cache/2026-general-text/header-strips/ (jas_*). Labels read left-to-right per page; every candidate's cells verified against the printed county TOTAL. The Circuit Court 13 Place 2 row (Stanley Sorey) was re-read at 1200 dpi column-by-column (coordinator render pass) and arithmetic-checked: p4 cells 193+526+428+240+746+280+372+169+233+172+649 = 4008, plus p5 Rose Hill 414 + Stringer 523 = 937, against the printed p5 TOTAL cell 4945.
extraction_note: Phase D fixes make pages 2 and 3 parseable: the widened three-data-line grid anchor recovers p2's five left columns (all 11 real columns c285..c738; the x~246 '1'-debris phantom still drops), and the declared page_min_columns floor of 2 moves p3's table top from Guest's row (y=308) up to the page's true first data line (Colom's row, y=200.3). p4/p5 remain unusable AT ANY FLOOR, so they are declared operator_supply_pages: p4's numeric clusters are 1-2 members each (17 clean tokens on the whole page among 11 columns) so the 3-member cluster floor holds nothing, and p5's first min_columns=2 line is the Circuit Court office header itself ('13' + '2' qualifier digits, y=170.6) -- a false top above the data. Their text-layer parse is therefore not used; the in-scope data on those pages (the Circuit Court 13 Place 2 row) arrives through the operator_rows entry below, keyed on these declared labels.
structure_note: Column-split pagination like Warren: p2+p3 are one logical table (13 columns = 12 precincts + TOTAL; p2 = columns 1-11 Antioch..Paulding, p3 = columns 12-13 Rose Hill, Stringer + TOTAL), and p4+p5 are a SECOND such table for the Circuit Court 13-Place 2 section (p4 = columns 1-11, p5 = Rose Hill, Stringer + TOTAL). Each race section's row prints in full under BOTH column sets with the office headers reprinted on every page. p2's vertical name stacks print bottom-aligned (Antioch, Bay Springs Beat 3, Bay Springs Beat 4, Claiborne, Heidelberg, Holders, Louin, Montrose, Moss, Moss East, Paulding); p3/p5's tail stacks are Rose Hill, Stringer, TOTAL. p1 is the certification cover page (Official Recapitulation 2026 General Election, no table). OPERATOR CELLS: this layer's cell digits are OCR-corrupted beyond repair on p4/p5, so the Circuit 13 Place 2 row (Stanley Sorey) is an operator_rows entry, not parsed cells: its cells key on the 0-based column-order index of these pages' declared labels (including p5's TOTAL column at index 2 -- there is no separate total override; the operator's read of the printed TOTAL cell 4945 is the row's total and the printed-TOTAL gate judges it). Every applied cell is recorded in pd[operator_cells_applied] and counted by the CLI. Other races are NOT operator-repaired: the OCR text layer's digit tokens on p2/p3 are also corrupted for many cells (e.g. Colom's Heidelberg 864 reads '8', Montrose 109 reads '101', the layer drops whole cells), so per-candidate runs cannot be certified from this layer alone and the printed-TOTAL gate holds the county accordingly.
truncation_note: No page-edge truncations on this document: Moss East is a complete printed name visible on p2 (also p4), new vs the county's 2026 primary precinct list (20260310__ms__primary__jasper__precinct.csv, 12 precincts); every other spelling matches the primary/2024 general lists.

local_note: p4/p5 below the Circuit Court 13-Place 2 row carry the local-races table (School District 1-E-School Board District Member 1 East, School District 1-W-School Board Member 1 West, Everline Jefferson Gilmore, Jean Barnes Wheaton, X-heavy cells); out of scope per the no-local-offices convention. Because p4/p5 are operator_supply_pages their labels never parse, so those local rows are not recorded under dropped_local_rows -- the operator entry's cells cover only the Sorey row, and the skip is recorded under pd[operator_supply_pages].
